scorecard.rationale: An older-adult trial of tulsi and cardamom extract did not publish a clear between-arm change in its accessible abstract. A Crohn trial measuring depression included cardamom in both groups. Ground cardamom and Parkinson depression remain unresolved. A primary perinatal cardamom diet study tracks growth, maze behavior and chemical outcomes in offspring. Place learning and probe task results do not measure depression after culinary intake in people with Parkinson disease.
